meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Remove AI-generated code smells (slop) from branch changes or an explicit file list. Locks behavior with regression tests FIRST, then runs categorized cleanup via parallel `deep` agents in batches of 5, then verifies with quality gates. Covers 10 slop categories including performance equivalences, excessive complexity (object annotations, if/elif variant chains), and oversized modules (250+ pure LOC with mandatory modular refactoring). MUST USE when the user asks to "remove slop", "clean AI code", "deslop", "clean up AI-generated code", "remove AI slop", or wants to clean up AI-generated patterns from recent changes. Triggers - "remove ai slops", "clean ai code", "deslop", "cleanup AI generated", "remove AI slop", "clean up AI-generated code", "strip slop", "ai-slop cleanup".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测并清理AI生成的代码坏味道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要清理AI助手生成的冗余或低效代码
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect and clean AI-generated code smells

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先为改动文件写回归测试锁定行为，然后并行清理 AI 生成的代码坏味（如多余注释、过度防御、死代码等），最后用质量门验证。
howto.when: 当你说“remove slop”“clean AI code”“deslop”等关键词，或要求清理 AI 生成的代码模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我清理最近改动中的 AI 代码坏味。
say.note: Claude 会分析分支差异并执行清理流程。

say.text: 对 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 执行 deslop。
say.note: Claude 会只处理指定文件。

say.text: 检查并清理代码中的过度防御和死代码。
say.note: Claude 会针对这两类坏味进行清理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first writes regression tests to lock behavior for changed files, then runs parallel cleanup of AI-generated code smells (e.g., obvious comments, over-defensive code, dead code), and finally verifies with quality gates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "remove slop", "clean AI code", "deslop", or similar keywords, or ask to clean up AI-generated code patterns.

say_en.text: Clean up AI code smells from recent changes.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze branch diff and run the cleanup process.

say_en.text: Run deslop on src/foo.py and src/bar.py.
say_en.note: Claude will process only the specified files.

say_en.text: Check and clean over-defensive code and dead code.
say_en.note: Claude will target those two categories.
